OUR PROCESS

From first call to registered title in four steps

01

Site View / Selection

We schedule a free AC car site visit to show you the venture in person. You inspect the land, road access, and layout boundaries with our team — no pressure, just the plot.

02

Documentation

EC check, patta verification, sale deed review, survey number mapping — every document is vetted by our legal advisors before you commit to anything.

03

Registration

Spot registration at the sub-registrar's office. You walk out with your title deed in hand, same day.

04

Delivery

Layout handover with all amenities complete — roads, drainage, plantation, electricity connection.
